schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE account_balance_history (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    debt_balance_amount REAL,

    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,

schema.sql:

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE investment_assets (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE loans (

CREATE TABLE raw_financial_messages (

    source_app TEXT,
    sender TEXT,
    raw_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    parsed_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    parsed_amount REAL,
    parsed_currency TEXT,
    parsed_merchant_name TEXT,
    parsed_account_hint TEXT,
    parser_name TEXT,

    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
  )

CREATE TABLE receipt_attachments (

    local_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
    merchant_name TEXT,

    currency TEXT,
    receipt_date TEXT,

    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE recurring_subscriptions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    merchant_name TEXT,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_id TEXT,
    subcategory_id TEXT,
    account_id TEXT,
    billing_day INTEGER,
    periodicity TEXT NOT NULL,
    next_charge_date TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, anchor_date TEXT, custom_interval INTEGER, custom_unit TEXT, generation_cursor TEXT, reminders_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"enabled":true,"offsets":[3,1,0],"hour":9,"minute":0}', schedule_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id)
  )
schema.name: recurring_subscriptions

schema.sql: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.name: schema_migrations

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_allocations (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shared_receipts(id),
    participation_id TEXT REFERENCES transaction_splits(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, participation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0 AND amount_minor <= 9007199254740991),
    active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.name: shared_allocations

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_commands (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_json TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.name: shared_commands

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_contacts (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(name)) > 0),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.name: shared_contacts

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_expenses (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, transaction_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions(id),
    total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(total_minor) = 'integer' AND total_minor > 0 AND total_minor <= 9007199254740991), date TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL,
    distribution_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','cancelled','deleted')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.name: shared_expenses

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_loss_events (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('forgiveness','forgivenessReversal','recovery','recoveryReversal')),
    expense_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shared_expenses(id),
    participation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shared_contacts(id),
    amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0 AND amount_minor <= 9007199254740991),
    date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(date) = 10), reason TEXT,
    related_event_id TEXT REFERENCES shared_loss_events(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    receipt_id TEXT REFERENCES shared_receipts(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK((kind = 'forgiveness' AND related_event_id IS NULL AND receipt_id IS NULL)
      OR (kind = 'forgivenessReversal' AND related_event_id IS NOT NULL AND receipt_id IS NULL)
      OR (kind IN ('recovery','recoveryReversal') AND related_event_id IS NOT NULL AND receipt_id IS NOT NULL)))
schema.name: shared_loss_events

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_receipts (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, transaction_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions(id),
    contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shared_contacts(id), amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0 AND amount_minor <= 9007199254740991),
    date TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','deleted')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.name: shared_receipts

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE shared_returns (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shared_receipts(id),
    transaction_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions(id), amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor > 0 AND amount_minor <= 9007199254740991),
    date TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','deleted')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.name: shared_returns

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE smart_alerts (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    alert_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    related_entity_type TEXT,
    related_entity_id TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    triggered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
  )
schema.name: smart_alerts

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE subcategories (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    category_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    color TEXT,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
  )
schema.name: subcategories

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE subscription_occurrences (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_date TEXT NOT NULL, expected_amount REAL NOT NULL CHECK(expected_amount > 0),
    actual_amount REAL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, account_id TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','overdue','paid','skipped')),
    transaction_id TEXT, paid_at TEXT, skipped_at TEXT, skip_reason TEXT, notes TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(subscription_id, expected_date),
    FOREIGN KEY(subscription_id) REFERENCES recurring_subscriptions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id),
    FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id)
  )
schema.name: subscription_occurrences

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE subscription_reminders (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT NOT NULL, offset_days INTEGER NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL, fire_at TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT NOT NULL,
    desired TEXT NOT NULL, applied_revision INTEGER, delivery_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    error TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(occurrence_id, offset_days),
    FOREIGN KEY(occurrence_id) REFERENCES subscription_occurrences(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )
schema.name: subscription_reminders

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE tax_tags (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
  )
schema.name: tax_tags

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE transaction_splits (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    split_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    shared_expense_id TEXT REFERENCES shared_expenses(id),
    contact_id TEXT REFERENCES shared_contacts(id),
    amount_minor INTEGER CHECK(amount_minor IS NULL OR (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor >= 0 AND amount_minor <= 9007199254740991)),
    shared_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(shared_active IN (0,1)),
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_id TEXT,
    subcategory_id TEXT,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories(id)
  )
schema.name: transaction_splits

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE transaction_tax_tags (
    transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    tax_tag_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (transaction_id, tax_tag_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tax_tag_id) REFERENCES tax_tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )
schema.name: transaction_tax_tags

schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE transactions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    date TEXT NOT NULL,
    civil_date TEXT,
    local_time TEXT,
    time_zone TEXT,
    date_precision TEXT,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    category_id TEXT,
    subcategory_id TEXT,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    direction TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_account_id TEXT,
    source_message_id TEXT,
    merchant_name TEXT,
    payment_method TEXT,
    credit_card_hint TEXT,
    dedupe_key TEXT,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (target_account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (subcategory_id) REFERENCES subcategories(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (source_message_id) REFERENCES raw_financial_messages(id)
  )
schema.name: transactions
